Terms & Conditions
Last Updated: May 2024

1. Acceptance
By downloading, accessing, or using FinCalc ("the App"), you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these Terms, you must discontinue use of the App immediately.

2. Eligibility
You must be at least 13 years of age to use this App. By using the App, you represent and warrant that you meet this age requirement and have the legal capacity to enter into this agreement.

3. Accounts
Certain features require account registration via Firebase Authentication or Google Sign-In. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You agree to notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.

4. Guest Mode
FinCalc provides a "Guest Mode" for limited functionality without an account. Data created in Guest Mode is stored locally on your device and will be permanently lost if you log out, clear app data, or uninstall the App. We accept no liability for data loss in Guest Mode.

5. Friends & Chat
The App includes social features allowing you to add friends and exchange messages. You agree not to send offensive, illegal, defamatory, or harassing content. We reserve the right to remove any content or suspend accounts that violate these standards.

6. User Responsibilities
You are responsible for the accuracy of any data you input into the App. You agree to use the App only for lawful purposes and in compliance with all applicable local, national, and international laws.

7. Acceptable Use
You may not: (a) reverse engineer, decompile, or disassemble the App; (b) use the App to distribute viruses or malware; (c) attempt to gain unauthorized access to our servers or networks; (d) use the App for any fraudulent purposes.

8. Intellectual Property
All design, code, branding, and content within the App are the exclusive property of the developer and are protected by international copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws.

9. Financial Disclaimer
FinCalc is a computational tool provided for general informational and educational purposes only. Results generated (e.g., loan interest, tax estimates, budget projections) are estimates and must not be interpreted as professional financial, investment, tax, or legal advice. Always consult with a qualified professional before making financial decisions.

10. Third-Party Services
The App utilizes third-party services including Google Firebase (Authentication, Firestore, Storage) and Google Sign-In. Your use of these services is subject to their respective terms and conditions.

11. Limitation of Liability
To the maximum extent permitted by law, the developer shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages, including loss of profits, data, or financial loss, arising from your use of or inability to use the App.

12. Account Suspension
We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to the App at our sole discretion, without prior notice, for conduct that we believe violates these Terms or is harmful to other users or the App's integrity.

13. Governing Law
These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the United Kingdom. Any disputes arising relating to these Terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the United Kingdom.

14. Contact
For any questions regarding these Terms, please contact: enoshjaques@gmail.com


Privacy Policy
Last Updated: May 2024

1. Data Collected
We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and profile picture. We also store data you generate through App features, including notes, budget entries, and messaging metadata.

2. Firebase Authentication
We use Firebase Authentication to secure your account. Google processes your email and login metadata to facilitate secure access.

3. Firestore
User profiles, friend lists, and messaging metadata are stored in Google Cloud Firestore to provide real-time data synchronization across your devices.

4. Firebase Storage
Media files, such as profile pictures, are stored securely in Firebase Storage.

5. Google Sign-In
If you choose to use Google Sign-In, we receive your name, email address, and profile picture URL from your Google Account to populate your FinCalc profile.

6. Friends & Messaging
When you use the "Friends" feature, your FinCalc ID and name are shared with users you choose to connect with. Messages are stored to enable real-time chat functionality.

7. Cloud Backup
Registered users can backup their app data (including notes, budgets, and settings) to Firestore. This data is associated with your account and is private to you.

8. Local Device Storage
Certain preferences, temporary cache files, and Guest Mode data are stored locally on your device to improve performance and provide offline access.

9. Analytics & Crash Reporting
We may use Firebase Crashlytics or similar tools to collect technical data about app performance and crashes. This information is used solely to improve the stability and user experience of FinCalc.

10. Security
We implement industry-standard security measures provided by Google Firebase to protect your information. However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.

11. UK GDPR Rights
Under the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), you have the right to: (a) access your personal data; (b) request correction of inaccurate data; (c) request deletion of your data; (d) object to or restrict processing. Contact us to exercise these rights.

12. Children's Privacy
FinCalc is not intended for use by children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors. If we discover such data, it will be deleted immediately.

13. Third-Party Services
Our App links to third-party services like Google Play Services. These providers have their own privacy policies governing how they handle your data.

14. Changes
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any significant changes by updating the "Last Updated" date on this page.

15. Contact
For any privacy-related enquiries or data requests, please contact: enoshjaques@gmail.com
